# Original GETAWAY UI material

`soil.png` was generated with built-in imagegen in one request. Original output 1254 × 1254, retained without edits.

Prompt: Generate exactly one original square 1024x1024 seamless, tileable earthen soil texture. Warm chestnut brown earth with chunky dark pixel pebbles and lightly mottled amber pixels. Crisp chunky pixel art for a blocky Minecraft-inspired game interface. Restrained low-contrast detail so cream UI text will remain readable over it. Straight-on flat texture filling every pixel, even visual density; opposite edges match seamlessly horizontally and vertically. No text, symbols, logos, watermark, objects, perspective, borders, variants, mockup, panels, or frame.
